blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filipinos are hardly short on malasakit (compassion). Even when there is little to spare, the instinct to help runs deep. Such cultural trait has helped sustain a strong tradition of giving in the Philippines. But goodwill alone cannot keep the social services offered by civil society running.
